label: Solids generated by rotation
subgoals: Slice the solid into discs of radius f(x) and thickness dx
Write each slice as pi times f(x)^2 times dx
Sum the slices into V = pi times the integral of f(x)^2

label: Example
subgoals: Read the disc radius sqrt(x) on the interval [0,4]
Square the radius to pi times x inside the integral

label: When the method applies
subgoals: Check continuity so the Riemann sums converge
Switch to washers when the region leaves the axis
Measure the radius from the true axis with |f|
